title: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales
intro: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales. Seven brand new stories have arrived, ready for tonight.
outro: New stories, same gentle voice, same starry bush. Subscribe, snuggle in tonight, and sweet dreams, little one.

text: Meet a busy little numbat, saying goodnight to the setting sun.
A gentle spotted quoll, curled up like a little spotted moon.
A cheeky bandicoot, digging one last supper in the evening grass.
A sleepy dingo puppy, waiting for his mama under the desert stars.
A tiny emu chick, tucked beneath his daddy's feather tent.
A blue-tongue lizard and a pink galah, with bedtime secrets to share.
